verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Crossmint serves an llms.txt at docs.crossmint.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). First-party docs also describe ingesting the docs into AI code helpers like Cursor and Copilot, via a server that returns only the most relevant sections for a query. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the agent-oriented docs server (setup and scope) and independent hands-on corroboration of agents using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Integrate faster with Crossmint by ingesting the docs into your AI-based code helpers (like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, etc.).
the server receives your query and returns only the most relevant sections
